basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm a 28-year-old gamer and travel enthusiast currently residing in the Cayman Islands. Originally from Turkey, I moved here for a job in the construction management sector. I'm passionate about video games, especially narrative-driven ones like Dishonored. When I'm not gaming, I love exploring local culture and cuisine. My hours online vary, but I'm often active during evenings and weekends. Single and enjoying it, I often browse Reddit to connect with people who share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in civil engineering, having studied at a university in Turkey. My interest in construction and project management led me to my current job in the Cayman Islands. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-taught, developed through years of playing and engaging with gaming communities online.
